batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit, academic session 2015-2016, Set-4 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.288-295 (printed pp.103-110 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); where both forms occur (Q30, Q37) they agree, and no tag-vs-solution disagreement occurs anywhere in this paper. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. TRUNCATION STATEMENT: the source book PDF ENDS at p.295 (printed p.110), which is the last page of this paper. The paper is nevertheless COMPLETE in the file: the two syllabus tiers together partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once — the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.288) carries 67 questions (Q1, 3, 4, 5, 7-17, 21-36, 38-50, 52, 53, 55, 56, 59-61, 63-67, 70-80) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.294, continuing on p.295) carries the remaining 13 (Q2, 6, 18, 19, 20, 37, 51, 54, 57, 58, 62, 68, 69). NO printed number in 1-80 is absent: the final printed item, Extra-Syllabus Q69 on p.295, is complete (full stem, all four options and a complete worked solution ending above the page footer), and nothing beyond it belongs to this paper, so nothing has been fabricated or padded for a missing tail. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Physics Q1-20, English Q21-35, Higher Mathematics Q36-75, Bangla Q76-80 — counts Physics 20, English 15, Higher Mathematics 40, Bangla 5. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.288 carries Short Q1, 3, 4, 5, 7-12; p.289 carries Short Q13-17, 21-27; p.290 carries Short Q28-36, 38-42; p.291 carries Short Q43-48; p.292 carries Short Q49, 50, 52, 53, 55, 56, 59; p.293 carries Short Q60, 61, 63-67, 70-72; p.294 carries Short Q73-80 and (Extra Syllabus) Q2, 6, 18, 19, 20, 37; p.295 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q51, 54, 57, 58, 62, 68, 69. Keys: 77 keyed single_choice, exactly ONE dual key — Q77 (Bangla), whose printed tag reads '[Ans: a, d]' because options (a) and (d) both print 'কৃতিত্ব' identically — encoded multiple_choice with both ids; 0 keyless; and exactly TWO printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q12 (printed solution headed 'সমাধান: (No answer)', computed acceleration 16.25 ms^-2 not among the options) and Q15 ('সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)', computed mean free path 4.16 × 10^-21 m not among the options); those two carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Preserved print anomalies: Q16's four options all print the symbol g with subscript c (g_c) although its solution works with g_e/g_m; Q17's stem prints the Young's modulus unit as Nm^2 (no minus) against the options' Nm^-2; Q20 options (a) and (d) print positive exponents (2 × 10^14 N, 4 × 10^13 N); Q41's stem calls the expression a^4 + a^2b^2 + b^4 a 'সমীকরণ' (equation); Q62's stem prints set A opening with a parenthesis '(-2, 0, 1, 2, 3}'; Q68's stem prints its set with a parenthesis 'S = (x : ...)' where its solution uses braces; Q72's printed solution closes with the book's own bracketed admission that the question is flawed ('[প্রশ্নটি ত্রুটিপূর্ণ বেগ 9.8 সে.মি./সে. ধরে অঙ্কটি সমাধান করা হয়েছে।]'); Q77 options (a) and (d) are identical. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram; diagrams/tables appear only inside printed worked solutions (Q44 alternative solution's 5-12-13 triangle, Q47's parallelogram of forces, Q51's combination/permutation table). Dynamics/statics-flavoured items (Q39, Q47, Q48, Q70, Q72) sit inside the Higher Mathematics number range and are assigned to Higher Mathematics by printed range, as throughout this pack. BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.287 belongs to the PREVIOUS paper (JU H Unit 2016-2017 Set-3) and is excluded; this paper begins with its header on book PDF p.288, and the book PDF file ends after this paper's last page (p.295), so there is no following paper in the file. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section; this paper's pages carry the banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৫-১৬') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-4 of JU H Unit 2015-2016 occupies printed pp.103-110 = book PDF pp.288-295, the final eight pages of the PDF: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.288-294 (banner on p.288) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.109 (book PDF p.294) and continuing on printed p.110 (book PDF p.295), where the file ends immediately after the paper's last item (Q69). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.288) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৫-২০১৬ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-4, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The preceding paper (JU H Unit 2016-2017 Set-3) ends on book PDF p.287. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image (300-dpi renders), with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at ~200%) for Q15-Q17, Q20, Q32, Q36-Q41, Q43-Q44, Q54, Q57-Q58, Q62, Q65-Q66, Q72 and the full Bangla/Extra blocks on pp.294-295. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical-style plain-digit conventions not needed in this paper).
